concerns.text: FR-005 states "...via bootstrapping with a sufficient number of resamples and a fixed random seed..." The phrase "sufficient number of resamples" is vague and not measurable. Specify an exact count (e.g., 1,000 or 10,000) so the requirement can be verified.

SC-001 only says "Median time-to-decision is measured against the baseline..." without a quantitative target. Add a concrete success threshold (e.g., ≥15 % reduction in median time‑to‑decision) so the criterion is measurable.
SC-002 similarly lacks a numeric goal. Define a required improvement (e.g., ≥5 % increase in correct‑first‑line identification rate) to make the success criterion testable.

SC-004 mentions matching results "within a reasonable numerical tolerance" but does not specify the tolerance. Provide an explicit bound (e.g., absolute difference ≤1e‑4 for p‑values and effect sizes) to enable reproducibility testing.
